name: Rik van Duijn
biography: Rik is a security researcher with 7+ years of experience as a penetration tester. Nowadays Rik focusses on malware research and defense. His hobbies include cooking, bouldering and long walks on the beach. Rik has presented at SHA2017, (whiskey|fristi)leaks, DefCon BlueTeam Village and Tweakers Security/DEV Meetups. @rikvduijn
